01 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curiosity is the start.
Building is the next step.

I’m Mayukh Jairaj, a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student specialising in Data Science at Mar Athanasius College of Engineering. Based in Kochi, Kerala, I’m passionate about transforming data into meaningful insights through Python, statistical analysis, data visualisation, and machine learning.

I enjoy problem-solving, technical innovation, and developing practical solutions. My interests also span computer networks and cybersecurity, with specialisation in Microsoft productivity tools. Winning an idea pitching competition strengthened my enthusiasm for finding problems worth solving.
